title: J&K chief secretary assures protesting paramedics to resolve recruitment rules issue in a month

ai.summary: Protesting paramedical employees in Jammu and Kashmir stopped a chief secretary's cavalcade to demand resolution of recruitment rules delays, which they say have stalled their careers and affected patient care for seven years.

facts.claim: Protesting paramedical employees in Jammu and Kashmir stopped the cavalcade of Chief Secretary Sajjan Singh Yadav in Rajouri
facts.quote: Protesting paramedical employees of government medical colleges in Jammu and Kashmir on Tuesday stopped the cavalcade of Chief Secretary Sajjan Singh Yadav in Rajouri

facts.claim: They have been protesting for the past seven years over the delay in framing and notifying their service recruitment rules
facts.quote: The non-gazetted employees have been protesting for the past seven years over the delay in framing and notifying their service recruitment rules

facts.claim: They claimed that the delay was affecting fresh recruitment in medical colleges, with adverse implications for patient care
facts.quote: They claimed that the delay was affecting fresh recruitment in medical colleges, with adverse implications for patient care

facts.claim: Protests are being held at all five newly established medical colleges — GMC Doda, GMC Rajouri, GMC Anantnag, GMC Baramulla and GMC Kathua
facts.quote: Protests are being held at all five newly established medical colleges — GMC Doda, GMC Rajouri, GMC Anantnag, GMC Baramulla and GMC Kathua

facts.claim: The paramedical staff earlier observed a three-day strike from November 16 to 19, while employees at GMC Rajouri have continued their protest for the past nine days
facts.quote: The paramedical staff earlier observed a three-day strike from November 16 to 19, while employees at GMC Rajouri have continued their protest for the past nine days

facts.claim: During their interaction with the chief secretary, the employees said they had been given repeated assurances over the past seven years, including a deadline for completing the process before September 30, 2026, but no concrete action had followed
facts.quote: During their interaction with the chief secretary, the employees said they had been given repeated assurances over the past seven years, including a deadline for completing the process before September 30, 2026, but no concrete action had followed

facts.claim: The chief secretary said he had assumed charge only three days ago but was aware of the issue and had already taken it up with the Secretary of the Health and Medical Education Department
facts.quote: He told the employees that the recruitment rules had been forwarded by the Health and Medical Education Department to the Finance Department and would subsequently require clearance from other concerned departments, including the Administrative Reforms and Inspections (ARI) and Trainings Department, before they are submitted to Lieutenant Governor Manoj Sinha for final approval

facts.claim: Yadav said he would convene a meeting of all concerned officers within the next 24 hours to expedite the process and ensure that the necessary approvals were obtained at the earliest
facts.quote: Yadav said he would convene a meeting of all concerned officers within the next 24 hours to expedite the process and ensure that the necessary approvals were obtained at the earliest

facts.claim: I will make every effort to complete the entire process within one month and put the case before the Lieutenant Governor for approval
facts.quote: I will make every effort to complete the entire process within one month and put the case before the Lieutenant Governor for approval

ai.background_note: Paramedical staff in Jammu and Kashmir have been protesting for seven years over delayed recruitment rules, which they say have stalled their careers and affected patient care.
